# Kolmari

> Kolmari is a relocation decision and planning platform. It helps people compare
> countries, review visa pathways, build a budget, and turn relocation research
> into a practical, tracked plan. It is not a travel-booking site.

## What Kolmari does

- Match Score: compares destinations against a user's Kolmari Profile (citizenship,
  household, timeline, priorities, budget).
- Kolmari Pathways: researched visa and immigration routes per country, each with
  official source links and a last-reviewed date.
- Move Plan: a step-by-step relocation plan with a documents checklist and
  readiness tracker.
- Cost Calculator: cost-of-living and housing estimates per destination.
- Greenbook Insights: curated, verified country guidance.
- Passport Index: Kolmari's own passport-mobility tool at /passportindex, built
  from the February 2026 imorte/passport-index-data dataset.
- Kolmari Guide (AI): an in-app chatbot that answers relocation questions and can
  search the web for current visa rules, rents, and prices. Answers are general
  information only, not legal or financial advice.

## Key public pages

- / : product overview
- /passportindex : passport power and visa-free access rankings
- /terms : terms of service
- /privacy : privacy policy (includes how the Kolmari Guide uses data)

Most planning features (/dashboard, /destinations, /pathways, /my-plan,
/cost-calculator, /greenbook) require a free account.

## Data and freshness

- Country safety data: US State Department travel advisories and the 2026 Global
  Peace Index, shown with source dates. Countries without a published score show
  the advisory label instead of a number; nothing is invented.
- Visa pathway content is researched per route with official sources and review
  dates. Pages without completed research say so explicitly.
- AI answers may be wrong; users are told to confirm visa details with the
  relevant consulate or immigration authority.

## Plans

- Explorer (free), Plus, and Navigator (paid). Prices are listed in-app on the
  Billing tab under account settings.
